english.meaning: thank you, for a gift, a compliment or a treat
english.note: Say 多謝 for a gift, a compliment or a treat. For a service or a small favor (a waiter, someone holding the door), say 唔該.

exampleSentences.english: I thank you for buying me lunch.
exampleSentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 faan6

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when appreciating someone’s help, effort, or kindness.

exampleSentences.english: I really appreciate you helping me move house.
exampleSentences.jyutping: zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

english.note: Use this when acknowledging a favour by expressing thanks.

exampleSentences.english: I acknowledge your help—thanks for helping me move house.
exampleSentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1
